values.name: Vitomir Maričić
values.bio: Vitomir Maričić is a Croatian freediver from Rijeka and a member of the city’s Ocean diving club. Ranked world no. 1 in 2025, he holds Croatian national records across pool and depth. In June 2025 he set the Guinness World Record for the longest breath held underwater with oxygen, 29 minutes and 3 seconds, to draw attention to ocean conservation. He is also an AIDA judge and president of AIDA Croatia.
